QuestInfo.0: Something could be wrong with the barrier. Go to the area near Pente to find clues.
QuestInfo.1: As you expected, the dark energy is far stronger than it was in Duo Base. Defeat #o9602663# and collect #t4037492#.
QuestInfo.2: For some reason, #p9201713# was absent from the meeting. You and the other captains decided that the five pillars and the barrier needed to be checked on, but...#p9201713# was the only person who could enter the Katanos piller, since he was chosen by the Illusion Orb. For the time being, everyone agreed to return to their own bases.
